title: 单仪器与双仪器野生眉，怎么选
title_en: Single or dual instruments: choosing a brow method
intro: 先看五官与骨相、原生眉和想要的风格，再讨论仪器数量。两种做法的区别在于线条与结构的组合，不是简单的高低档。
intro_en: Start with facial features and bone structure, existing brows and the desired style. The distinction between single and dual instruments concerns the combination of strokes and structure, not a simple hierarchy of devices.

sections.title: 单仪器：顺着原生眉补充
sections.title_en: Single instrument: working with existing brows
sections.description: 按原生毛质选择电流仪或半抛机：细软色浅与粗硬色深的毛发，可能需要不同的线条处理。主线与辅线结合，讨论基础轮廓和毛流的补充。
sections.description_en: The instrument is selected for the existing hair texture: fine, light hairs and coarse, dark hairs may call for different stroke treatment. Main and supporting strokes are used to refine the outline and hair flow.

sections.title: 双仪器：框架与绒毛层次配合
sections.title_en: Dual instruments: structure and fine detail
sections.description: 在适合采用主线条与绒毛线组合的设计中，主线条先建立主要结构与毛流方向，突出眉部与眉眶骨之间的视觉立体关系；绒毛线再丰富疏密、深浅与虚实，让线条自然衔接。目标是有框架、有层次、有自然毛流，并与五官协调，不是把所有空隙填满或单纯加深。
sections.description_en: Where a combination of main and fine strokes is appropriate, main strokes establish structure and hair direction, bringing out the visual relationship between brows and brow bone. Fine strokes then vary density, tone and definition to connect the lines naturally. The aim is a framework with layers and natural hair flow that complements the features, not filling every gap or simply adding darkness.

sections.title: 适合哪一种，需要现场设计
sections.description: 眉毛基础、旧底色、肤质以及个人喜好都要一起看。双仪器可以讨论更丰富的层次，但不等于每个人都需要。留色时间常参考约2–3年，实际因人而异，所有项目一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: Existing hair, old pigment, skin and personal preference all matter. More layering is an option, not a requirement for everyone. About two to three years is a retention guide for instrument work, not a promise. All services include free touch-ups within one year.
